WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) as avg_points 
  FROM driverStandings ds 
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId 
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0 
  GROUP BY r.name
), 
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg 
  FROM step1
) 
SELECT step1.name, step1.avg_points, step1.avg_points - step2.overall_avg as diff 
FROM step1 
CROSS JOIN step2 
WHERE step1.avg_points > step2.overall_avg 
ORDER BY diff DESC
